info.name: Dataiku DSS Public API
info.description:
REST API for managing Dataiku DSS instances, projects, datasets, recipes, jobs, scenarios, models, and other platform resources programmatically. Provides full control over DSS operations including data preparation, machine learning model management, and workflow automation.

Contact Support:
 Name: Dataiku Support
 Email: support@dataiku.com
